method:
Actual new-region UI and production rules in isolated software Chromium.
Accelerated walking/depth probes are labelled; they do not measure human feel or GPU speed.

checks.name: exact offline build loads
production walk reaches 11,9
initial kit is command-earned before any chapter
production walk reaches 18,6
atlantis terms show objectives, kit requirement, exact rewards and free return
atlantis has explicit crossing confirmation
atlantis normal crossing preserves ownership while its clock runs
atlantis physically supported scene opens
production walk reaches 8,-16
gallery normal frame loop is unpaused
G actually descends through production held-key frames
released G holds physical depth
F actually ascends through production held-key frames
W actually swims using camera-relative input
gallery journal pauses simulation
modal consumes depth and camera shortcuts
camera exchange preserves physical swimmer depth
compact gallery rejection displays a real transient toast
compact depth information stays inside the viewport
compact depth information and transient toast occupy separate space
Escape freely returns swimmer home
normal frame controls have no runtime errors

normal_keyboard_phase: Isolated software browser, real frame/input loop; accelerated walking setup. No GPU or human pace claim.
